bridge_assumptions.interpretation: Market/private retention factors combine mark-date, liquidity, valuation and tax uncertainty. They are model assumptions, not tax estimates. Do not additionally subtract all 22.819B DTL.
bridge_assumptions.preferred_treatment: Deduct 19.25B liquidation value as conservative claim-value proxy; denominator excludes preferred conversion shares. No extra preferred dividend deduction in FCFF. Alternatively model conversion shares and preferred coupon PV, without also deducting principal.
bridge_assumptions.leases: Operating lease expense remains in EBIT/FCFF; do not subtract 18.037B operating lease liability. Finance leases may be debt-like only if FCFF includes future finance-lease asset investments but excludes debt principal.
bridge_assumptions.NCI: 7.1B book-value proxy, not verified fair value. Deduct only when enterprise CF includes full consolidated subsidiary CF.
bridge_assumptions.SBC: Do not add SBC back to cash flow and also ignore dilution. If treated as ongoing economic expense, current-share denominator is a coherent base; future issuance is scenario risk.
bridge_assumptions.operating_cash_reserve: 20–40B arbitrary operating liquidity assumption. Avoid double count if another model already includes required cash in operating working capital.
bridge_assumptions.commitments: Do not deduct nominal 811B purchase commitments or 85.2B uncommenced leases in full if capex/rent forecasts already reflect their economic cash uses.
bridge_assumptions.deferred_tax: Q2 gain-specific tax basis not fully separated. Whole company 19.1% ETR is not a valid exact tax rate for removing the gain.

limitations: Financial assets have not been marked from June30 to Oct27; haircut spans uncertainty rather than pretending known current market values.
Q3 disclosure must replace June30 inputs once released.
TTM EV/EBIT multiple grid is a cross-check, not an intrinsic DCF or a 3–5 year return forecast.
No automatic buy or approved allocation.
